title: Uma-Maheshwar
detailed_description: Ornamented, headless, relief of Uma-Maheshwar image (mutilated) seated in abida (folded legs with feet touching each other) posture. parvati is seated on the lap of her spouse. The couple is embracing each other. Both the deities are depicted with elaborate ornamentation. Heads and hands of the deities are broken and attributes are lost.
